text: RGTI is down 50% and 70% below its 52-week high with revenue declining and cash burning — the thesis has completely broken down and this position should be closed.
QBTS is down 38% and 57% below its 52-week high with missed earnings and ongoing cash burn — reduce the position now to limit further damage while the thesis is still uncertain.
AVAV is down 37% and 61% below its 52-week high — one of the weakest performers in the portfolio and the risk/reward no longer justifies current sizing.
GORO is down 32%, 29% off its 52-week high, and has missed earnings three times — cut the position to reduce exposure to a consistently underperforming holding.
AEP has confirmed a stage transition with VCP/accumulation patterns in a supportive rate-easing environment that historically favours regulated utilities — this is a high-conviction new entry.
MU has the strongest fundamental setup in the portfolio with 49% revenue growth and a below-market valuation — adding here builds on a position with a clear and intact thesis.
